title: The Plot to Destroy the Randhawa Singhs

blocks.text: The surviving Singhs did not disappear into anonymity; by taking refuge yet keeping their dress code and identity intact, they preserved both visible Sikh form and the possibility of renewed resistance.
That persistence provoked local enemies into conspiracy, and the page says plainly that they wanted to get the Randhawa Singhs massacred before the line could gather strength again.

Their greed matched their hostility, because They should first get the Singhs land transferred to their names, and so they unfolded their (evil) plan before the Mughals as both political intrigue and property seizure.
